_monthFolderNote: The ONLY thing to change each month. The folder holding this month's photos + BA subfolders, a sibling of ICE-CUBE-TOOLS.
_agentNote: The model phases 4 and 7 call to READ AN IMAGE. It must be able to see one: a model that cannot does not error, it answers anyway, so the reading would look real and be a guess. deepseek-v4-flash is the one that works here.
_ignoreFoldersNote: Subfolders of the month folder that are NOT BA folders and must be skipped when scanning. ICE-CUBE-NOTA holds the flat copies for manual entry; __pycache__ is Python build output.
